mapper.select: SELECT p.plan_name FROM cultivation_plan AS p WHERE p.member_id = #{memberId} AND p.plan_status = '진행' AND p.actual_start_date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY p.plan_name, p.plan_id
SELECT DISTINCT g.greenhouse_name FROM cultivation_plan AS p JOIN greenhouse AS g ON g.greenhouse_id = p.greenhouse_id WHERE p.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY g.greenhouse_name

SELECT d.diary_id, d.plan_id, p.plan_name, c.crop_name, c.variety_name, g.greenhouse_name, d.worked_at, d.growth_stage, d.stage_change_reason, d.created_at, d.updated_at FROM cultivation_diary AS d JOIN cultivation_plan AS p ON p.plan_id = d.plan_id JOIN greenhouse AS g ON g.greenhouse_id = p.greenhouse_id JOIN crop_stage_standard AS s ON s.standard_id = p.standard_id JOIN crop AS c ON c.crop_id = s.crop_id WHERE d.diary_id = #{diaryId} AND p.member_id = #{memberId} AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND g.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT d.growth_stage FROM cultivation_diary AS d JOIN cultivation_plan AS p ON p.plan_id = d.plan_id WHERE d.plan_id = #{planId} AND p.member_id = #{memberId} AND d.worked_at >= DATE_ADD(#{workedDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY d.worked_at ASC, d.diary_id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT p.plan_id, p.plan_name, g.greenhouse_name, c.crop_name, c.variety_name, p.actual_start_date FROM cultivation_plan p JOIN greenhouse g ON g.greenhouse_id = p.greenhouse_id JOIN crop_stage_standard s ON s.standard_id = p.standard_id JOIN crop c ON c.crop_id = s.crop_id WHERE p.member_id = #{memberId} AND p.plan_status = '진행' AND p.actual_start_date IS NOT NULL AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND g.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY p.plan_name, p.plan_id
SELECT p.plan_id FROM cultivation_plan p WHERE p.plan_id = #{planId} AND p.member_id = #{memberId} AND p.plan_status = '진행' AND p.actual_start_date IS NOT NULL AND p.deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE

SELECT d.diary_id FROM cultivation_diary d JOIN cultivation_plan p ON p.plan_id = d.plan_id WHERE d.diary_id = #{diaryId} AND p.member_id = #{memberId} AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE

SELECT growth_stage FROM cultivation_diary WHERE plan_id = #{planId} AND growth_stage IS NOT NULL AND ((deleted_at IS NULL AND worked_at < #{workedDate}) OR (NULLIF(TRIM(stage_change_reason), '') IS NOT NULL AND worked_at < DATE_ADD(#{workedDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY))) ORDER BY worked_at DESC, diary_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM cultivation_diary WHERE plan_id = #{planId} AND worked_at >= DATE_ADD(#{workedDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND (deleted_at IS NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(stage_change_reason), '') IS NOT NULL) )
mapper.update: UPDATE cultivation_diary SET updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE diary_id = #{diaryId}
